brief:
Deprivation of drinking water has become a new Israeli policy used as collective punishment against Gaza detainees held in military detention facilities controlled by occupation forces and the Israeli Prison Service, Shehab Wire reported. Official reports prepared by the military prosecution documented the practice, according to the agency.

The measure affects prisoners across multiple military-run detention centers under Israeli control.
